newsitem.title: USA: Tacoma utility seeks 700 MW for industrial users.
newsitem.headline: Tacoma utility seeks 700 MW for industrial users.

text.p: Tacoma City Light is seeking power supply proposals to serve up to 700 megawatts (MW) of industrial customer loads, the municipal utility said Wednesday.
A formal request for proposals will be issued on Friday, with a final decision expected on or about May 5.

The request is for bids of up to 100 MW each of seven power supply products, including 100 percent load factor energy, heavy load power, light load power, California-Oregon border indexed power, daily pre-scheduled capacity, 70 percent load factor power, load shaping services and load following services.
The power will be supplied under Tacoma's new service as an agent for industrial customers to access the wholesale energy market.
